title: [Wear] Display/Rounding error when setting preset temp target from AAPS Wear
symptom: There appears to be a rounding/display error when setting a preset temp target from the watch. It only appears with some mmol values (eg. 9.8 and 9.6 but not the other numbers surrounding this) so I wonder if perhaps there is some sort of rounding bug when/if it is converted to mg/dL and back again??
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but the issue suggests a rounding bug when converting between mmol and mg/dL.
fix: The fix is proposed in a pull request (PR #3838) and later merged via commit f27d6799. The PR likely corrects the rounding/display error. The thread does not provide specific details of the fix.
evidence_quote: My proposal to fix this, works fine on my end: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3838
